evidence.says: LC records birth year 1973, citing the ECIP data for Prisoner of the infidels (2021). It also cites The Ottoman age of exploration (2010) and an EUI page identifying Casale as professor of early modern Mediterranean history. Its external identifiers include Q106610236, VIAF 88401665, GND 140900683 and ISNI 0000000107190802.

Giancarlo Casale is described as a historian and academic. P244 is n2009030688; VIAF, GND and ISNI match LC. P496 is 0000-0003-4541-4728, exactly matching the graph's ORCID. P569 stores +2000-00-00T00:00:00Z with precision 7 and no reference.
Precision 7 means a century, and timestamps from 1901 through 2000 represent the 20th century. Thus this item's P569 value is compatible with 1973 and does not assert an exact birth year of 2000.
The graph's Open Library author identifier names Giancarlo Casale.
This author's works include The Ottoman age of exploration and Prisoner of the Infidels, matching the works cited by LC.
EUI identifies Giancarlo Casale as professor of early modern Mediterranean history and a historian of the early modern Ottoman Empire.

notes: The birth_disagrees flag appears to result from treating a century-precision Wikidata timestamp as an exact year. LC supports 1973; the identifiers and works establish the same person.
